samples.notes: Different X-Trans generation from fuji_xt3_xtrans. P19 T1: patch 06 (LIBRAW_DECODER_TRYRAWSPEED3) did NOT flip this sample at RawSpeed3 pin de70ef5f (2021-09-10) -- backend measured libraw_native both before and after (scripts/tmp/p19/t1_eligibility.txt), because that pin predates the X-T5 body (released 2022) and its cameras.xml has no matching camera entry. P19 T3: measured NOT to flip at the re-pin to c835b05a either, DELIBERATELY NOT FLIPPED (evidence-based, per round-2 mandatory requirement). X-T5 IS listed in the re-pinned cameras.xml (Task 2 grep hits), and the LIBRAW_DECODER_TRYRAWSPEED3/fuji_width entry gate is satisfied (fuji_width=0, same as fuji_xt3), so the file IS offered to RawSpeed3 -- it is not skipped by any pre-filter. process_warnings measured 0x00012000: LIBRAW_WARN_RAWSPEED_UNSUPPORTED set (rawspeed3_capi's decodefile() returned a status that is neither rawspeed3_ok nor rawspeed3_not_supported), LIBRAW_WARN_RAWSPEED3_NOTLISTED clear (rules out a camera-metadata-listing gap -- checkSupport() in rawspeed3_capi.cpp:157 did not throw), LIBRAW_WARN_RAWSPEED3_PROBLEM clear (rules out the previously-hypothesized 'Size mismatch' throw at unpack.cpp:172, and rules out any other exception escaping the capi's outer try in rawspeed3_capi.cpp:137-191). Re-running the same file with LIBRAW_RAWSPEEDV3_IGNOREERRORS additionally set (unpack.cpp:163-168's rawspeed3_ok_warnings admission path) produced the IDENTICAL result (still libraw_native, same warning bits) -- this rules out 'decoded with non-fatal warnings' (rawspeed3_ok_warnings) as the status, since IGNOREERRORS would have admitted that case. The remaining candidates consistent with all four measurements are rawspeed3_no_decoder (RawParser found no matching Decoder subclass for this specific RAF variant, cameraMeta listing notwithstanding) or rawspeed3_processing_error (an exception was thrown and caught INSIDE rawspeed3_capi.cpp:187-191, never propagating to unpack.cpp, so it cannot set RAWSPEED3_PROBLEM). Distinguishing between those two requires instrumenting the vendored RawSpeed3 C API return path, which is out of Task 3's owned-files scope (vendored tree is read-only except via the patch mechanism) -- recorded as a parking-lot item, not fixed here. Net: RawSpeed3 c835b05a's own decoder logic declines this X-T5 RAF body; this is upstream/vendor behavior, not a LibRaw dispatch-policy gap this project controls. Measurement: scripts/tmp/p19/t3_xt5_smoke_final.txt, scripts/tmp/p19/t3_xt5_smoke_ignoreerrors.txt.

samples.notes: NOT a router corpus sample: expect_route is frontend_only, and the RawFileRouter still sends every DNG to the Adobe DNG SDK route. This entry exists solely to exercise LibRawFrontendContext's forced-backend switch, which needs one file that LibRaw will actually hand to RawSpeed3. LibRaw decodes it via lossless_dng_load_raw(), whose decoder_flags carry LIBRAW_DECODER_TRYRAWSPEED3, so forced kRawSpeed3 reports rawspeed3 and forced kLibRawNative reports libraw_native on the SAME file. No RAW sample in this checkout can do that: see scripts/tmp/verify/t6_finding_rawspeed3_eligibility.md. Replace this entry once a real RawSpeed3-eligible generic RAW (compressed ARW/CR3/NEF/RAF) is supplied.
